independent_static_review.scope: Package schema, exact source loading, retained failed gate, target main/tag identity, multipart/sidecar digests, draft-first publication and failure preservation.

coverage: Constructed passed and failed scientific gates retain exact status
Exact externally pinned package and audit identities
Ninety source hashes and twelve-checkpoint/51-row/native-work coverage
Current publisher and pinned package source included in archived manifest and exact pushed target commit
Multipart ordered segment upload without uploading duplicate complete archive
Digest, upload, moved-tag and public-sidecar failures retained without automatic retry
Nonzero API errors are not accepted as release absence
Explicit authorization and exclusive existing-output guards
Hash-pinned exact source-byte loading bypasses timestamp-valid stale bytecode
limits: All package assets and receipts are synthetic stand-ins; no real archive was created or inspected.
Git, GitHub and public-sidecar downloads are mocked; tests establish orchestration, not live publication effectiveness.
Pure byte and manifest validation uses the actual SHA-pinned package helpers.
No current scored execution or audit outcomes were read.
No publication, package creation, network action, model call or native replay occurred.
